explanation: `crop_relative_path` on every E7-B package row was always correct: it is relative to `PreprocessingRunContext.output_root`, which `_build_e7b_run_context` places at `<package_root>/m2_run` for both the scientific package namespace and the engineering smoke namespace. The package manifest itself (SIW_SOURCE_PACKAGE.json / TARGET_PACKAGE.json) is written one level up, at `<package_root>` (i.e. `package_manifest_path.parent`). Four consumers -- e7b_validate()'s SiW-source crop check, e7b_validate()'s MSU/CASIA target crop check, _resume_completed_video_ids(), and _resume_completed_target_ids() -- all resolved crops directly against `package_manifest_path.parent` instead of `package_manifest_path.parent / 'm2_run'`, so every real, on-disk, hash-verified crop was reported as a false 'successful crop does not resolve on disk'. Fixed via ONE new helper, `_e7b_m2_output_root(package_manifest_path) -> package_manifest_path.parent / 'm2_run'`, used by all four consumers (and `_crop_resolves`'s parameter renamed to `m2_output_root` to make the contract explicit). No persisted data was rewritten: crop_relative_path values, package rows, package_identity, population_identity and split_identity are all untouched -- verified via a real-GPU-package-layout regression fixture whose crops live ONLY under m2_run/ (the old wrong `<package_root>/crops/...` location is asserted absent) and four resume tests (A: valid crop at the correct root is accepted; B: crop entirely missing fails closed; C: sha mismatch fails closed; D: a decoy file at the OLD wrong location does not fool the check -- it still fails closed, proving the correct root is actually being used, not merely 'some file that happens to exist').
